comments.text: Lore time.  So Cory, back in Security Breach you destroy Glamrock Chica in a trash compactor and run over Roxy with a golf cart taking Chica's voice box and Roxy's eyes.  What people thought was the cannon ending was the ending where you go underground and burn the old pizzeria on fire destroying everything, but this game confirms that the 3 Star/Princess Quest ending was the cannon one.  This ending involves you freeing Vanessa from glitch trap (The antagonist from the VR games) and Gregory, Vanessa, and Glamrock Freddy leave the pizzaplex.  The reason the Pizzaplex is.destroyed is because of an earthquake that occurred and with the sink hole underneath the pizzaplex leading to the buried pizzeria the damage was more severe.  The reason why the pizzaplex hasn't been leveled is because Fazbear Entertainment seemingly is still trying to rebuild it.  I believe that is all I can give without spoiling anything, I hope this helps. (Also there is a real Freddy Fazbears pizza you can eat at universal studios as well as a haunted house)
